_about: Human review of huts whose OSM description or note suggests they may be closed, ruined or restricted. Free text cannot be trusted to a keyword match: on the first pass about half the matches were wrong ("the refuge is open, simply closed by an iron door"; "a ruined hut restored in 2019"). Structured tags (access=private, demolished:*, historic=ruins ...) are applied automatically; free text only nominates a hut for review, and finalise_shelters.py refuses to write the data while any nomination is unreviewed. Statuses: ok | closed (cannot count on sleeping here) | gone (ruined, demolished or abandoned - not a place to sleep). caveat is shown to the hiker on an ok hut.

node/7425418126.name: Refuge de l'Abérouat
node/7425418126.reason: Permanently closed after judicial liquidation (reported 2026-08). Only a small day room remains, for eating under cover.

way/847472702.name: Cabane de la Baigt de Saint-Cours
way/847472702.reason: Reported closed in 2025-06; the spring still runs.

node/968204230.name: Cabane de Coume Nère
node/968204230.reason: Closed in summer, occupied by the shepherd. A rough shelter for 2 stands beside it.

way/223961544.name: Cabane de Peyrehitte
way/223961544.reason: Open and in good condition; it is the neighbouring hut that is locked.
way/223961544.caveat: No water at the hut - the trough was empty.

node/968202948.name: Cabane Pastorale du Col de Part

way/433028352.name: Cabane d'Aouen
way/433028352.reason: Small room always open; the larger room may sometimes be locked.
way/433028352.caveat: The always-open room is 2.5 x 2 m with one mattress; the larger room may be locked.

way/434540345.name: Refuge forestier d'Arreau
way/434540345.reason: Forestry (ONF) refuge, closed. Picnic tables only.

node/963678657.name: Cabane de la Jasse de Bretounels
node/963678657.reason: Half is reserved for the shepherd and locked; the other half is open.
node/963678657.caveat: Only the open half is available: 4 places on a sleeping platform.

way/961125532.name: Cabane du Campalou
way/961125532.reason: Built 2021; expected to be closed in summer because the shepherd uses it.

way/1190335340.name: Cabane de Garsan
way/1190335340.reason: Shepherd's part locked; open part usable.
way/1190335340.caveat: Open part takes up to 4, partly filled with salt sacks in summer. Bring a mat; no firewood nearby.

way/997314985.name: Cabane Matutano
way/997314985.reason: Refuge closed; usable only as emergency shelter (gendarmerie / mountain rescue).

node/2306350014.name: Abri de la Balmère
node/2306350014.reason: Rock shelter; 'closed' refers to plastic sheeting around the sleeping area.
node/2306350014.caveat: Rock shelter, room for 2-3 behind plastic sheeting.

node/519720623.name: Refuge forestier de la Mouline
node/519720623.reason: Refuge open; only the forestry (ONF) section is locked.

node/963754407.name: Refuge des Vigourats
node/963754407.reason: Open; 'closed by an iron door' means it has a door.

relation/20517366.name: Refugio de Viadós
relation/20517366.reason: Staffed refuge (guardado). The matched text described its free section, which opens when the staffed part is closed.

way/283382215.name: Refugi forestal de Baserca
way/283382215.reason: Largely destroyed (2017); a scrap of roof gives cover in a storm and nothing more.

way/685462416.name: Sarrahèra de Baish
way/685462416.reason: Catalan 'porta tanca correctament' means the door closes properly.

way/226919736.name: Venta espagnole
way/226919736.reason: Derelict ruin, apparently squatted. Floor space in bad weather only - emergency cover, not a planned night.

way/184628892.name: Cal Pelo
way/184628892.reason: Solid roadman's hut. 'Of no interest in summer' is an opinion about its roadside position, not a closure.

way/333405233.name: Cabane d'Arrégatiou
way/333405233.reason: Three enclosed rooms, free to hikers all year.

way/847571788.name: Cabane du Liantran
way/847571788.reason: Former ruin restored in 2019: new frame, roof, door and sleeping platform.

relation/12151536.name: Refugi de la Pleta del Duc
relation/12151536.reason: May be locked by the shepherd during summer grazing; the description says to contact him.

way/838137348.name: Orri des Légunes d'en haut
way/838137348.reason: Stone vault partly collapsed - not safe to sleep under.

way/127125424.name: Refugi de Juclar
way/127125424.reason: Staffed from early June to the end of September.
way/127125424.caveat: Staffed early June to end of September only.

way/864933562.name: Abri du Pla del Bouc
way/864933562.reason: 'Porte fermée' describes the room being dark with the door shut.
